title: Comment on status morph-gpu "End-of-page morph on the GPU": We didn't land them into v8 ? why ?

messages.text: We didn't land them into v8 ? why ?

It is not in v8 yet because v8 has not been built: the build starts when 2 or more of its parts are ready.

- The fix (rev 3) is finished and on main, ready to go in.
- The row said 'finished (nothing to land)'; that was my wrong label from a minute ago. I changed it to 'waiting for the v8 build'.
- v8 parts today: countdown faces (landed), countdown roll and accent word (checks running), this morph fix (ready).

What you need to do: nothing.

Yes. This fix will land in v8.

- It is finished and on main already.
- It goes into the v8 build, which the integrator is putting together now.
- Before v8 is final, it gets a short phone check that it is no worse.

What you need to do: nothing.
